question: For each mailing list that involves subscribers that work in departments with names starting with 'Computer Science', state the ownership type, the list name, the number of owners, and the number of subscribers. Display the ownership type only if it differs from the previous entry. Include subtotals (the corresponding type field shoud be 'SUBTOTAL') for each ownership type and a grand total (the corresponding type field shoud be 'TOTAL') across all ownership types.

prediction.sql:
WITH cs_employees AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ed.KRB_NAME
    FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'Computer Science%'
),
qualifying_lists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
      AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IN (SELECT KRB_NAME FROM cs_employees)
),
list_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        o.OWNER_TYPE,
        o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
    WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY IN (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY FROM qualifying_lists)
),
list_subscribers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY IN (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY FROM qualifying_lists)
),
list_stats AS (
    SELECT
        lo.OWNER_TYPE,
        lo.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY) AS num_owners,

    FROM list_owners lo

        'SUBTOTAL' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        SUM(num_owners) AS num_owners,
        SUM(num_subscribers) AS num_subscribers

MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_student_years, s1.STUDENT_YEAR, s1.num_students, s1.avg_students_per_year, s1.range_students_per_year, s1.var_students_per_year, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_student_years, NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR, NULL AS num_students, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS range_students_per_year, NULL AS var_students_per_year, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, STUDENT_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID), DepartmentUnitVariation AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), DepartmentMaxUnits AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, dmu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation AS duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentMaxUnits AS dmu ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, t0.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, t0.IS_PUBLIC, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, t1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, MIN(t1.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY ORDER BY t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS min_mit_id FROM `MOIRA_LIST` AS t0 JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = t1.MOIRA_LIST_KEY WHERE t0.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND t0.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(list_key) OVER (ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort) = list_key THEN NULL ELSE list_key END AS list_key, list_name, is_public, member_full_name, member_mit_id, last_update_date, min_mit_id FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 1 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_KEY END AS list_key, CASE WHEN GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_KEY) = 0 AND GROUPING(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE MOIRA_LIST_NAME END AS list_name_sort, MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name, MAX(IS_PUBLIC) AS is_public, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME) AS member_full_name, MAX(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS member_mit_id, MAX(LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS last_update_date, MIN(min_mit_id) AS min_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY list_key_sort, list_name_sort

WITH StudentEECS AS (SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM `SE_PERSON` AS sp JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID), DepartmentUnitVariation AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT s.MIT_ID, s.FULL_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.running_sum_mit_id, d.coefficient_of_variation FROM StudentEECS AS s JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.MIT_ID

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery2 AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT dept FROM DepartmentsWithHighVariance) ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS > 1), cte2 AS (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cte1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE, cte1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte1.window_column, cte1.SCHOOL_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME, cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.SCHOOL_NAME_DEPT, cte1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, cte2.highest_running_sum_total_units FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SCHOOL_CODE = cte2.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY cte1.SUBJECT_CODE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), subj_counts1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN ('5', '7') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DeptStats AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.avg_enrolled_students, ic.var_enrolled_students, MIN(min_office_phone) AS min_office_phone FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(num_unique_subjects) > 0), PoliSciStats AS (SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SUBJECT_CODE, ed.FULL_NAME AS responsible_faculty_full_name, ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS responsible_faculty_email, rr.total_unique_subjects, rr.min_office_phone FROM RollupResults AS min_office_phone FROM DeptStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS avg_enrolled_students, NULL AS var_enrolled_students, NULL AS stddev_enrolled_students, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, p.SUBJECT_CODE, p.responsible_faculty_full_name, p.responsible_faculty_email, p.total_unique_subjects, WITH cs_employees AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ed.KRB_NAME
    FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'Computer Science%'
),
qualifying_lists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
      AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IN (SELECT KRB_NAME FROM cs_employees)
),
list_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        o.OWNER_TYPE,
        o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
    WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY IN (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY FROM qualifying_lists)
),
list_subscribers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY IN (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY FROM qualifying_lists)
),
list_stats AS (
    SELECT
        lo.OWNER_TYPE,
        lo.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY) AS num_owners,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM list_subscribers ls WHERE ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lo.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS num_subscribers
    FROM list_owners lo
    GROUP BY lo.OWNER_TYPE, lo.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
subtotal_rows AS (
    SELECT
        OWNER_TYPE,
        'SUBTOTAL' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        SUM(num_owners) AS num_owners,
        SUM(num_subscribers) AS num_subscribers
    FROM list_stats
    GROUP BY OWNER_TYPE
),
grand_total AS (
    SELECT
        'TOTAL' AS OWNER_TYPE,
        'TOTAL' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        SUM(num_owners) AS num_owners,
        SUM(num_subscribers) AS num_subscribers
    FROM list_stats
),
combined AS (
    SELECT OWNER_TYPE, MOIRA_LIST_NAME, num_owners, num_subscribers, 1 AS row_kind FROM list_stats
    UNION ALL
    SELECT OWNER_TYPE, MOIRA_LIST_NAME, num_owners, num_subscribers, 2 FROM subtotal_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT OWNER_TYPE, MOIRA_LIST_NAME, num_owners, num_subscribers, 3 FROM grand_total
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(OWNER_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN OWNER_TYPE = 'TOTAL' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END, OWNER_TYPE, row_kind, MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = OWNER_TYPE
        THEN NULL
        ELSE OWNER_TYPE
    END AS OWNER_TYPE,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    num_owners,
    num_subscribers
FROM combined
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN OWNER_TYPE = 'TOTAL' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END,
    OWNER_TYPE,
    row_kind,
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME

    FROM EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY ed
    WHERE ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE 'Computer Science%'

    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
      AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IN (SELECT KRB_NAME FROM cs_employees)
),
list_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        o.OWNER_TYPE,
        o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER o ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
    WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY IN (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY FROM qualifying_lists)
),
list_subscribers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
        ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER
    FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
    JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY IN (SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY FROM qualifying_lists)
),
list_stats AS (
    SELECT
        lo.OWNER_TYPE,
        lo.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY) AS num_owners,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM list_subscribers ls WHERE ls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lo.MOIRA_LIST_KEY) AS num_subscribers
    FROM list_owners lo
    GROUP BY lo.OWNER_TYPE, lo.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
),
subtotal_rows AS (
    SELECT
        OWNER_TYPE,
        'SUBTOTAL' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
        SUM(num_owners) AS num_owners,

    GROUP BY OWNER_TYPE
